options.a: Slow to 20 mph with hazard flashers on and continue to the next stop
options.b: Stop in a safe place and not continue until visibility is safe
options.c: Turn on the defroster and continue, since it clears the glass
options.d: Finish the route, then report the wipers on the post-trip form

distractorExplanations.a: Slowing down with hazard flashers does not restore visibility in heavy rain; without wipers the driver must stop in a safe place.
distractorExplanations.c: Defrosters clear fog on the inside, not heavy rain on the outside; working wipers are required.
distractorExplanations.d: Failed wipers in heavy rain are an immediate safety defect; reporting them later does not make continuing safe.
